title: Pascal Extremes
summary: A Lean 4 formalisation of sharp p-adic extremal behaviour for the restricted binomial gcd G(N;m) = gcd{C(N,k) : 0 = 2 with p not dividing m, it proves that the maximum of v_p(G(N;m)) over admissible rows is the least r >= 1 with m = 2, the exact least-row formula T_p(p^a+1) = p^(3a)+1.

review.reason: Lean formalization of p-adic extremal behaviour for restricted binomial gcds.
